page_title: UNI 0-3 RBL | Union Berlin v RB Leipzig 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from RB Leipzig comes to nothing.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
88' Substitution. Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) has come on for Benjamin Henrichs.
88' Marco Rose has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Emil Forsberg (RB Leipzig) replacing Xavi Simons.

87' 0 - 3 Goal! Dani Olmo clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), who jumps highest and steers a bullet header from the centre of the box into the top of the net. Frederik Ronnow had no chance of stopping that. 0:3.
86' Here is a change. Robin Gosens is going off and Urs Fischer gives the last tactical orders to Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Kevin Behrens cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' 0 - 2 GOAL! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) runs onto a pass from Xavi Simons after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 0:2.
84' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
82' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow is equal to it and makes an easy save.
81' The referee shows a yellow card to Janik Haberer (Union Berlin). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
81' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) has tested the patience of referee Daniel Schlager and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' Xavi Simons floats over the corner and Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
76' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

76' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the top left corner. Frederik Ronnow pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
75' The substitution is prepared. Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yussuf Poulsen.
75' Marco Rose decides to make a substitution. Lois Openda will be replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
72' A clumsy foul by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle. RB Leipzig win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) comes onto the pitch for Josip Juranovic.
71' Urs Fischer has decided to substitute Aissa Laidouni and he is replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
70' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
69' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. RB Leipzig will take a corner kick.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mohamed Simakan as he is replaced by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
66' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
64' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) is sent off by the referee for a disgraceful tackle that simply has no place in football!
63' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
62' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
61' Substitution. David Datro Fofana will be replaced by Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin).
60' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
60' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
56' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
55' Kevin Kampl (RB Leipzig) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats well wide of the right post.
53' David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) fails to direct the ball into the net from the resulting set piece. His effort goes well wide of the left post. Such a squandered chance!

51' 0 - 1 Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) finds himself in a great shooting position after receiving a low pass from Benjamin Henrichs just outside the box. He unleashes a spectacular first-timer which goes in off the crossbar. Phenomenal stuff! 0:1.
50' The corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is intercepted by Janis Blaswich.
48' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
47' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniel Schlager stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Frederik Ronnow into a superb diving save to keep it out.
45' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes a short corner kick.

45' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. RB Leipzig force a corner. They send men into the box.
41' Union Berlin are ruled offside.
40' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
40' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
33' A rebound sits up nicely for Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the left post and out for a goal kick.
32' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
31' The total number of attempts is 1:3. 1:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alex Kral (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
27' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
26' It must be a yellow card. It is. Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
26' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle after Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Union Berlin are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
23' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
22' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick.
21' Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) jumps into a tackle and Daniel Schlager signals a foul. RB Leipzig will take a free kick near the side line.
21' David Raum (RB Leipzig) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
20' A first-time shot by Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. The ball is out of play. RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner.
19' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

18' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads under the crossbar, but is stopped by a great save from Frederik Ronnow. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to RB Leipzig.
15' Xavi Simons links up with Yussuf Poulsen (RB Leipzig), who fires just over the bar from the edge of the box.
14' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

13' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the right post. His effort, however, is blocked by Janis Blaswich, who pulls off a stunning save! Corner kick. Union Berlin will have an opportunity.
11' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) sends a long ball forward to David Raum, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
10' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) attempts to find Lois Openda, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
9' The cross into the penalty area from David Raum (RB Leipzig) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
5' The ball is cleared after David Datro Fofana (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
4' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of David Datro Fofana, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
2' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Union Berlin will have the kick-off.
Daniel Schlager was nominated as the referee for this game.
